text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"And with that, it seems Fine Motion's 
final race has been decided. On our 
program today—"

I look at the circled date on the 
calendar. The true, final moment is 
drawing closer at last.
choice_data_list:
...I wonder what the right way to spend 
this time is.

text_block_list.text: (Ding-dong)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning, Trainer! Sorry to bother 
you on your day off♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you see—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Want to go hang out? I haven't decided 
where yet, though.
choice_data_list:
...Alright, let's go to the place that 
popped into your head!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: *Sluuuuuurp!*

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It's really not complete without 
this, huh♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's true~. I mean, when you think of 
the first place that comes to mind, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"How many times have we come here to eat? 
After training, after races, and on 
ordinary days..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, if we count them all, the noodles 
are going to get soggy!
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's eat before they get soggy 
and move on!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, Trainer! It's a family 
restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back... I got the wrong idea and 
tried to make you my family, didn't I?"
choice_data_list: Oh right. That really surprised me...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, dear brother! I want to eat 
parfaits with you again!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, dear sister! I want to eat 
parfaits with you again!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What's up? Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you want the drink bar too? Should I 
make you another 'Mystery Juice'? Or maybe 
you'll make one for me? Just kidding♪
choice_data_list:
H-Hey, hold on... Well, I guess it's 
fine~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We'll split a giant parfait... and then, 
you have to help me pick out clothesâª I 
want to try picking out sisterly matching 
outfits!
choice_data_list:
H-Hey, hold on... Well, I guess it's 
fine~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ufufu!

And so, Fine Motion and I strolled around, 
spending the time wherever our whims took 
us.

—Before long, the sun had already begun to 
sink. In the distant sky, deep indigo had 
already begun to spread.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, can we stop to do some shopping? 
Chinese noodles and... green onions, 
chashu... and corn too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thanks! Once that's done...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Nope! I was just checking if we missed 
anything on the shopping list. Yup, with 
that last item—we're all set!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Thanks for today, Trainer! See 
you tomorrow, then!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer! Do you think we could... 
stay just a little longer after all?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, welcome! One Fine-dou special 
miso ramen coming right up!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh. This is the finale bowl for 
today, after all. I poured my whole heart 
into serving it up!

I take the first slurp. The rich yet 
comforting miso and butter coat the 
noodles. Instantly, my chopsticks can't 
stop moving.

Feeling a sudden gaze, I look up. Fine 
Motion was staring intently right at me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to burn it all into my memory. 
Every single piece of it, all together.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll wake up from this dream soon. But if 
I close my eyes, I'm sure I'll be able to 
remember it again.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Even when we're covered in wrinkles, 
we'll surely be able to return to being 
just ordinary girls.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
... Let us dance like a dream, until the 
very end.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Promise!
